facts.fact: 尽管 Kiamling 一上船就显出外行，把 The Arrow 驶离港口的仍是 Hoi；裂隙透出的蓝光像直视太阳般刺眼。
facts.anchor: Despite Kiamling’s clear incompetence on a ship, Hoi managed to steer The Arrow away from the harbour.

facts.fact: 裂隙里又爬出一只她认得的生物 wandun（混沌的太古怪物，像发脾气的幼儿）：六条短腿、四只翅膀，桶状身子圆如猪，没有头也没有脸。
facts.anchor: This one she recognised: six stubby legs, four wings and a barrel-shaped body as round as a pig. Oh, and no head or face.

facts.fact: Hoi 复述并接受了她的计划：把整条船变成巨大的符、直接驶进裂缝；他这次没挑刺，多半是别无选择——等于送死。
facts.anchor: He had not picked holes in her plan for once, likely because they were running out of options. Certain death it was.

facts.fact: 她手蘸掺了鸦片的鸡血，把「字句之力」写上主帆：Stop 写得最多，另有「门里折起的怪物」「围栏中的盐与银」「饿人旁的虎与猪」「护命的刀」。
facts.anchor: With her hand dipped in her bottle of opium-laced chicken’s blood, she wrote the words of power on the mainsail.

facts.fact: Hoi 瘫在甲板上、身下渗出一滩血：胸口与肩膀被抓开，手臂见骨；他睁眼只说「我真不喜欢那家伙」就倒下（她先前把甲板上散落的断绳错看成一群白蛇从他身边游开）。
facts.anchor: Claw marks tore down one side of his chest and shoulder. She could see bone through the flesh of his arm.

facts.fact: Archie 的影兽与以往不同：在岛上待得越久、维持这个形态越久就演化得越多；头更圆、像狮鬃，额上穿出一只火角——正是除夕夜巡街的 nin sau，把本地犬形传说连同英国传说一并吸收。
facts.anchor: But his head was rounder, more like the shaggy mane of a lion, and a single fiery horn pierced his forehead.

facts.fact: 船身倾斜，那一剑落在影兽侧腹而非头顶；银币剑确实有效，穿透烟雾层切进实体血肉，血是深蓝色——但只是皮外伤。
facts.anchor: The silver coins cut true, burning through the smoky layer and into solid flesh. His blood splattered dark blue from the wound as he roared in pain.

facts.fact: 她认定 Archie 与 Lancaster 只是干扰，真正要紧的只有合上裂隙。
facts.anchor: Archie and Lancaster were but a distraction. She needed to close the rift, that was all that mattered.

facts.fact: 既然他此刻是 nin sau，就该怕巨响强光：她点着一把香当飞镖连连扎进他背脊（他挠不到的两肩之间），又掷出一束燃烧的符晃瞎他。
facts.anchor: If he was the nin sau now, then he would be vulnerable to loud noise and bright lights. Good. No one had ever accused her of being subtle.

facts.fact: Archie 把她扑倒，沉重巨爪上的火透过衣服烧进身体；痛从肩膀贯到肋腔，她能感到经脉一条接一条闭合。
facts.anchor: He knocked her to the ground, the flames in his heavy claws burning through her clothes and deep into her body.

facts.fact: 她喊「Archie，please」时，那双红眼有一瞬变蓝又变回去，像是幻觉；她确信他还在里面，只要够得到他。
facts.anchor: Red eyes flickered blue for a second, then back. As if she had imagined it. He was in there, she was sure of it.

facts.fact: Lancaster 把枪口顶到她头上、扳下击锤；缠斗中那几枪也都是他开的（「What’s taking you so long? Sic her!」），他嫌 Archie 迟迟不下手，骂「胆小的平民」办不成事。
facts.anchor: The police captain’s scowling face entered her line of vision, pistol pointed towards her head. So impatient, Kiamling thought as he cocked the hammer.

facts.fact: Por Por 双脚勉强踩在一把直剑的剑身上飞来，剑如箭般直冲 Lancaster；Jingling 骑在她背上欢呼指点，长辫飘在身后。
facts.anchor: Her grandmother soared through the air with both feet balanced precariously on the flat of a straight sword.

facts.fact: 是 Jingling 冲上前点中 Lancaster 的定身穴，手枪当啷落地；她又推了一把，让僵直的他后仰翻过栏杆落进翻涌的水里。
facts.anchor: In a blur of speed, she pressed on Lancaster’s paralysis points. His pistol fell to the deck with a clatter.

facts.fact: Por Por 的符只用传统字句，只让 Archie 缩了一下、伤不到他——事出太急，Kiamling 忘了事先教祖母针对外来怪物的改法；祖母拿挂着八卦镜的棍子挡，镜面被一击砸碎，人被甩到桅杆上昏过去。
facts.anchor: In all that had happened, she had forgot to prep her grandmother on the adaptations to fight the foreign monsters.

facts.fact: 她掏出 Lady Bowring 赛马会送她的粉盒镜（已改装进八卦镜的八角框）：破镜不吉利，但这镜子到手时就已破，霉运落在镜上而不在她；裂镜把 Archie 照成碎裂的怪物，他嚎叫着后退、眼睛又闪蓝。
facts.anchor: Kiamling yanked out the compact mirror Lady Bowring had given her at the races, modified to fit into a batgua mirror’s eight-sided frame.

facts.fact: 此前符确实生效：帆上符号逐笔发白、裂隙边缘抖动并开始合拢；随后「Then it stopped.」——帆上的符彻底消失，裂隙依旧张着。
facts.anchor: The fu on the sail vanished entirely, as if they had never been. The rift remained, still gaping open.

facts.fact: 亮光中一个巨人踏出裂隙：人身、三倍于常人、毛覆头背、拖着树一般大的棍，把船推到一边、把主帆撕得像宣纸；符不够强，他们只能漂在水上眼看怪物毁掉家（章末）。
facts.anchor: Another bright glow pulsed its ragged edges as a huge monster stepped through, shoving the vessel to one side as though it was no more than an inconvenience.
